caption: The drawing is a square design featuring a symmetrical floral pattern with a color palette of red, blue, and cream. The central motif consists of a large blue flower with stylized petals and foliage, flanked on either side by blue leaves and stems. Surrounding the central motif, there are two large red flowers with detailed petals and red leaves, one positioned in the upper left and the other in the upper right, each mirrored from one another. Below these central elements, there are two red floral branches with small buds or berries, curving upward and outward from the bottom corners. Small blue geometric and star-like shapes are scattered in the upper central area, while elongated blue tassel-like ornaments are present on the left and right edges of the main floral section. The lower border features a geometric band with alternating red and blue diamond shapes, each containing a small colored circle, set against a cream background with red detailing. At the bottom right corner, outside the main composition, the name “WM. HOFFMAN” is printed. The overall background of the main design is cream, with fine pinkish vertical lines for texture, enclosed within a double border of thin red lines.
title: Coverlet
